activeSlice.scope: Correct the HI2-11 pre-gate findings without changing rollout thresholds: use a three-topic-per-run operational retrieval plan with deterministic topic rotation and one distinct exploration topic, and enforce the certified EEI exploration maximum during fallback selection. Preserve the achieved cost/latency gains and detailed evidence output.
successCriteria: Operational V2 retrieves exactly three bounded lexical intents per run when at least three topics exist.
Two core topic intents and one exploration intent use three distinct topic IDs when the discovery plan has at least three topics.
Topic selection rotates deterministically by comparison ID across repeated runs so a six-topic Brand is not permanently narrowed to the same three topics.
All three operational intents are eligible for the existing three-paid-intent budget; no additional paid searches are introduced.
Per-run retrieval coverage remains >=0.85 under the unchanged readiness metric.
EEI fallback selection never raises exploration above the certified explorationMax=0.20 while preserving the exploration minimum target when eligible evidence exists.
3x3 pre-gate cost ratio remains <=1.5 and p95 latency ratio <=1.5.
3x3 pre-gate quality delta remains >=-0.02, failure rate <=0.05, and topic share <=0.34.
Only after the corrected 3x3 pre-gate passes may the full 30-pair shadow gate run.
Hunter V1 remains production authority; no V2 persistence, canary, scheduler, or production enablement.
PES v2 CI and Security baseline pass before merge/deployment.
